move: six tinted photo tiles swap grid slots, each pass a new blend
how: A 3x2 grid of 352x274 image tiles, each with a colour-blend tint overlay, over a drifting aurora paper. Every 0.25D a permutation of order four moves each tile to its next slot over 0.9s (expo.inOut) with a 0.06s stagger per column; during the move the tile scales to 1.12 and tilts 3 degrees (power2.out) then settles, and its mix-blend-mode is switched to difference, screen, exclusion or lighten for that pass so overlapping tiles flash inverted or bleached colours mid-flight, then back to normal. An index counter updates each pass; four passes return every tile home.
adapt: Replace the six background images and --tint colours, the caption; keep the perm array (a 4-cycle plus a 2-cycle) or pick another permutation whose order divides the pass count so it returns home.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .paper and the six .tile divs with the shot's images; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with passes at i*0.25D. Scope '.tile', '.idx', '.paper' to el.
caveats: the paper drift (scale 1.05 to 1.1, xPercent -1 to 1) does not return, so the background jumps slightly at the loop
blend-mode switches are tl.set calls and are scrub-safe, but mid-flight blends depend on image content
